startupConfigs.description: Widget presets to launch automatically when Zebar starts. Each entry identifies an installed widget pack, a widget in that pack, and one of that widget's presets.

items.description: An installed widget preset that Zebar launches on startup.

pack.description: ID of the installed widget pack, for example 'glzr-io.starter'.

widget.description: Widget name from the pack's zpack.json 'widgets' array.

preset.description: Preset name from the selected widget's 'presets' array.
